batches.name: default_9s_oversized_import
batches.interpretation: Separate unchanged-default 9000ms run. Both profiles timed out; completed receipts retained without activating coverage.

counter_semantics.imported_48_turns: Synthetic fixture records and scripted acknowledgements, not 48 real-model generations.
counter_semantics.recovery_pending: Expected infrastructure terminal when this input exhausts bounded maintenance steps. It is not a generated model answer or a latency pass.
counter_semantics.active_watermark: Only committed snapshots advance it. Staged progress remains separate.
counter_semantics.input_estimates: Serialized UTF-8 engineering upper estimates, not provider tokenizer counts.
counter_semantics.usage: Provider-reported usage for recorded completed calls; cancelled calls may have unreported billed usage.
counter_semantics.storage_reopen: Reopens SQLite and clears context/tool cache while HTTP session ownership remains. Full RuntimeStore restart/new-owner fencing is tested with scripted models.
